items.title: NATO vows space defence after Russia nuclear satellite report

The media reports, citing unnamed German military and BND spy agency sources, said Moscow was thought to be planning such a launch in the coming weeks, giving it the capability to destroy other satellites. FRANCE 24's Laurent Berstecher reports.

items.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO
items.summary: In a stunning U-turn, Nvidia's board has reinstated Jensen Huang as the company's President and CEO. The announcement came just days after the board rejected a petition calling for the tech titan's return. US President Donald Trump said had personally got in touch with the board to advocate for his return. Nvidia's stock surged 32%, adding nearly $1 trillion to its market cap while the rest of Wall Street also rallied.

items.title: 'A war of unmanned machines, AI and total transparency of the battlefield'
